items.review_rationale: Read graph connectivity on a nonempty simple undirected graph through existence of finite walks for all ordered vertex pairs, allowing trivial walk for equal vertices.

references.phrase: finite walk from u to v
references.context: Finite vertex sequence with consecutive vertices adjacent, including length-zero singleton walk when u=v.
Universal vertex-pair quantification in the nonempty graph.

references.phrase: nonempty vertex set and zero-length walks
references.disposition: Connectivity excludes empty graph by convention and permits u=v by zero-step walk.

items.review_rationale: Read eigenvalue of field-linear endomorphism by nontrivial kernel of A minus scalar identity, and preserved scalar field and operator domain-codomain match.

references.context: Linear endomorphism respecting addition and scalar multiplication on vector space V.
Kernel contains a nonzero vector, rather than merely the zero vector.

references.disposition: Lambda must belong to the scalar field of V, not an eigenvalue in an unstated field extension.

items.review_rationale: Read equivalent eigenvalue equation A(v)=λv for some nonzero vector and linked to same field-linear operator context, without requiring every vector to satisfy it.

references.context: K-linear map from vector space to itself.
Vector v distinct from zero satisfying the displayed scalar-eigen equation.
Image of selected nonzero vector is its scalar multiple by λ.

references.disposition: Exactly one witness vector suffices for eigenvalue status; the equation need not hold for all vectors.

items.review_rationale: Read exponential generating function of a real sequence only on the real convergence domain of its n-factorial-weighted power series, retaining nonnegative indices and convergence.

references.context: Product of integers from 1 to n with 0!=1, appearing in each coefficient.
Set of real z where series Σ(a_n/n!)z^n converges.

references.disposition: Does not assert entire real line convergence; outside D series does not define real value.
